characters.name: Amy
characters.clothing: Amy wears a sturdy leather apron dyed deep brown with worn patches at the elbows and pockets for tools. Underneath, she sports a simple linen shirt in off‑white that reaches her waist, tucked into dark woolen breeches cinched by a leather belt. Her knees are covered by thick calf‑high leather boots polished to a shine. A small brimmed hat of felt sits atop her head, its color matching the apron. The ensemble is completed with a silver chain necklace bearing a tiny oak leaf charm
characters.occupation: medieval barkeep and tavern caretaker for magical humanoid creatures
